label: The inspector sequencer runs momus, then argus, then nemesis, each finished before the next starts and each on its own model and effort; momus's business-process gap rows become priority targets for argus and nemesis; a scoped run adds a read-only team review; the security bar is appended to every phase, and the run ends with one combined summary and a security roll-up.
desc: After a Step 0 scope lock and workflow arguments, inspector dispatches three phases strictly in order, each awaited before the next: momus on Opus/high establishes a read-only release-readiness baseline across areas A to I and files nothing here; argus on Sonnet/high hunts on that baseline and files issues; nemesis on Opus/high red-teams the live dev app last and files issues, after checking its hard gate — on a failed gate it files a BLOCKED issue and the phase returns blocked. Momus's business-process gap rows are handed to argus and nemesis as priority targets. A scoped run adds a read-only team review (product and ux in parallel, then qa/tests alone). The security bar is appended to every phase prompt. The run returns one combined result with a security roll-up by attacker and ASVS ID. A phase stopped by its own gate returns blocked and the sequence continues; a phase that returns nothing stops the sequence.
title: /inspector — momus, then argus, then nemesis
